'''Sech Govlinder''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and an emissary to [[Orlin Denache]], magister of the [[Taloraan City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Orlin Denache|Denache]] secretly signed a treaty with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who was interested in making Taloraan a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]]. Dooku, however, felt that the treaty was worthless and decided to take over the city's [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] operations himself. A [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Canteval]] was sent to the planet and local CIS supporters led by [[Rynert]] began to smuggle [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]] into the city.

Meanwhile, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived at [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] to ensure that the planet remained loyal to the Republic, accompanied by Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Denache realized that the Jedi would detect his lies with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], so he feigned illness, with Sech Govlinder being sent to negotiate in his place. Govlinder was unaware of Denache's alliance with Dooku and was told that Denache avoided meeting with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to ensure no [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] would be played on him.

However, after the first round of negotiations, Ahsoka Tano went into the city and accidentally discovered [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stocked within a guarded warehouse. After being informed about the incident, Canteval ordered the droids to attack her and the other Jedi, revealing the CIS presence within the city. Kenobi and Skywalker accused Govlinder of treachery and tried to reach their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class shuttle]], but were incapacitated when the shuttle was destroyed. Govlinder insisted that instead of being killed the Jedi were taken into custody.

Govlinder himself felt manipulated by Denache and remained loyal to the Republic. Once he had the chance, he immediately freed both Jedi and returned to them their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Afterward, he led them to the city's central communication tower, where the Jedi were able to patch a message to their [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Govlinder himself rallied several remaining loyalists, who, with the help of the Jedi and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator]], were able to overcome Rynert and his men. Facing a dead-end, magister Denache committed suicide by stepping off the edge of the city and falling into the core of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]. Temporarily taking the rule on the city, Govlinder continued negotiations with the Jedi. He also acknowledged the support of the [[Wind Raiders/Legends|Wind Raiders]], who also played a small part in the skirmish.
